title: Family Booking & Mahram Linking
outcome: An authenticated customer can build one account-owned family travel party, link travellers through explicit Mahram relationships where required, and carry the validated party into quote, booking and journey workflows without duplicating travellers or weakening privacy boundaries.
actor: Authenticated NoorPath customer managing travellers owned by their account.
modules: Travellers owns account-scoped traveller identity, profile facts and duplicate prevention.
Family Booking owns family-party composition and relationship declarations.
Booking consumes an immutable validated party snapshot and does not rewrite traveller or relationship records.
Pricing consumes traveller composition and occupancy inputs without inventing Mahram eligibility.
Documents and Visa consume traveller identifiers and approved relationship projections only.
Accounts owns authentication and account isolation.
routes: Family travellers -> Add or edit traveller
Validated family party -> Quote and booking
My Journey -> Family and Mahram summary
acceptance: Customers can create, edit and archive account-owned travellers without accessing another account's travellers.
A family party can contain one or more existing account-owned travellers and rejects duplicate membership.
Mahram links are explicit directed relationships between two travellers in the same account and family party.
The relationship type and supporting declaration are recorded without making NoorPath the legal or religious authority for eligibility.
Self-links, duplicate active links, cross-account links and links to archived travellers are rejected.
Party validation identifies missing or invalid Mahram links according to the approved configurable policy and returns clear corrective guidance.
Policy evaluation is versioned so a booking retains the exact rule version and validated relationship snapshot used at checkout.
Concurrent edits use optimistic concurrency and return recoverable stale feedback.
Quote and booking creation accept only an account-owned, currently valid party and copy an immutable traveller and relationship snapshot.
My Journey shows the booked family composition and customer-safe Mahram summary without exposing sensitive document data.
Every create, update, archive, link, unlink and validation action is auditable using opaque identifiers and privacy-safe telemetry.
Loading, empty, validation-required, stale, permission-denied, not-found and service-error states are complete and accessible.
Customer surfaces extend the approved NoorPath visual language and pass keyboard, focus, reflow, target-size, reduced-motion and WCAG checks.
exclusions: Automated religious rulings or guarantees that a relationship is legally or religiously sufficient.
Document-based kinship verification, OCR or government-registry integration.
Cross-account traveller sharing, invitations or delegated family management.
Child or infant pricing changes beyond passing authoritative traveller facts to Pricing.
Room allocation, seat assignment, visa-provider integration or operator overrides.
Editing traveller or Mahram facts after booking in a way that mutates the immutable booking snapshot.
